mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a flight to safety, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales growth signal a broad-based demand contraction, which triggers a negative S&P 500 return over the next 60 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth over the past month signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100 for two consecutive months, it indicates a contraction in manufacturing output that signals an impending recession, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in GDP growth and housing starts indicate a severe demand shock that triggers a flight to safety, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, a decline in retail sales growth signals weakening consumer demand that precedes a market correction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during late-cycle expansion when RSAFS declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
